discussions.title: Signal-first CRUD: one list page per table
discussions.body:
<!--
slug: signal-first-crud
description: One list page for every table with Angular 22 resource() and a typed Resource.
-->
Pidrang turns a Supabase table into a typed `Resource`, and one generic list page renders all of them.

## The "resource" contract: signals first

`injectResourceList` wraps `DataProvider.getList` in Angular's `resource()`.

```ts
const list = injectResourceList<Row>('users');
```

| Part | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `resources` | One `Resource` per table |
| `dataProvider` | Reads and writes rows |
| `fields` | Types for the table and the form |

discussions.title: Why @pidrang/core knows nothing about Material
discussions.body:
<!--
slug: ui-agnostic-core
description: The core package holds contracts and signals only, so Material, Tailwind and PrimeNG can each build on it.
-->
The core package depends on `@angular/core` and nothing else.

> A UI package can be replaced without touching the contracts.

- `@pidrang/material` renders with Angular Material.
- `@pidrang/tailwind` renders the same API with utility classes.

See [the architecture notes](https://github.com/pidrang/pidrang/blob/main/docs/architecture.md).
